description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named GameActivity, which demonstrates how to implement an immersive game UI with system UI flags, including a nested Content class that manages game view rendering, UI visibility, and user interaction.

classes.name: GameActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating immersive game UI using system UI flags, including a nested Content class for game view rendering and control.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: A nested static class extending TouchPaint.PaintView that manages game rendering, system UI visibility, user interaction, and pause/resume functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and initializes the game content view.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Lifecycle callback, currently just calls super.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the game when the activity is paused.

methods.name: Content.init
methods.description: Initializes the Content view with references to the activity and play button, setting up user interaction.

methods.name: Content.onSystemUiVisibilityChange
methods.description: Handles changes to system UI visibility, updating internal flags and ensuring UI remains hidden when needed.

methods.name: Content.onWindowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Pauses the game when window visibility changes.

methods.name: Content.onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Optionally pauses the game when window focus is lost.

methods.name: Content.onClick
methods.description: Handles play/pause button clicks to toggle game pause state.

methods.name: Content.setGamePaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state of the game, updates UI elements, and manages the fade handler.

methods.name: Content.updateNavVisibility
methods.description: Updates system UI flags to implement immersive mode while the game is not paused.
